profile.name: M Mani Chandana
profile.about: Data Analyst and Data Scientist passionate about transforming raw data into meaningful business insights using Python, SQL, Power BI, Statistics, and Machine Learning.
profile.hero_lines: I build clean dashboards, practical analytics workflows, and machine learning experiments that turn raw data into decisions.

skills.name: Python
skills.desc: Leveraged Python to transform raw data into actionable insights through data cleaning, analysis, visualization, and machine learning. Applied libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Scikit-learn to solve data-driven business problems efficiently.

skills.name: SQL
skills.desc: Harnessed SQL to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets, enabling meaningful business insights and informed decision-making. Developed optimized queries using joins, aggregations, subqueries, and window functions for analytical reporting.

skills.name: Power BI
skills.desc: Designed dynamic and interactive Power BI dashboards that transformed complex datasets into intuitive visual stories. Utilized data modeling and DAX calculations to monitor KPIs and support strategic business decisions.

skills.name: Machine Learning
skills.desc: Applied machine learning techniques to uncover patterns, predict outcomes, and solve real-world business challenges. Built predictive models through data preprocessing, feature engineering, algorithm selection, and model optimization.

skills.name: Statistics
skills.desc: Utilized statistical methods to identify trends, validate assumptions, and support data-driven decision-making. Applied concepts such as hypothesis testing, probability distributions, correlation analysis, and statistical inference to derive meaningful conclusions.

skills.name: EDA
skills.desc: Uncovered hidden patterns and valuable insights through comprehensive exploratory data analysis. Leveraged statistical summaries and visualizations to understand data behavior, identify anomalies, and prepare datasets for advanced analytics.

skills.name: Model Development
skills.desc: Developed end-to-end machine learning solutions by transforming raw data into predictive models. Applied feature engineering, model selection, and optimization techniques to create robust and scalable analytical solutions.

skills.name: Model Evaluation
skills.desc: Evaluated machine learning models using appropriate metrics and validation techniques to ensure their performance and reliability in real-world applications.

projects.title: Natural Gas Storage Valuation & Forecasting
projects.description: Prediction of natural gas storage valuation using machine learning regression models.

Utilized Python for forecasting, valuation, and financial analysis.
